tasks.short: Check hours, shift allowances and pay changes before they go into AFAS.

today.trigger: Daily attendance updates or approved pay changes arrive before the payroll cutoff.
steps: Collect attendance records and approved adjustments from the three sites.
Match employees, dates and hours to AFAS records.
Check overtime, shift allowances and effective dates against the applicable CAO.
Ask managers to resolve missing approvals or conflicting records.
Post approved information and retain supporting evidence.
today.time_sinks: Assumed current workflow: inconsistent site files and late approvals create repeated checks; the attendance source has not been specified.

lenses.faster: Import approved records once and run employee, date, duplicate and CAO checks automatically. Manual checking concentrates on exceptions.
lenses.autonomous: A new approved attendance file triggers validation and posting of records that meet every configured rule. Conflicts enter a review queue.
lenses.ambitious: Check every site's hours daily, giving managers time to fix problems before payday. Measure recurring errors by source and rule.
lenses.joy: Remove copying and repeated arithmetic. Keep resolving difficult cases and explaining pay fairly to employees.
lenses.options: Show the pay effect of each supported interpretation of an ambiguous allowance. Identify the evidence needed to choose between them.
lenses.altitude: Own the rules, approval requirements and quality of attendance inputs across all three sites.
reach: Help HR Administration standardize attendance submissions.
Give the Controller evidence of recurring payroll input errors.

tasks.human_edge: Interpret disputed CAO provisions and resolve conflicting evidence with managers; an attendance anomaly alone must never reduce someone's pay.
tasks.pattern_why: Employee matching, approved adjustment posting and explicit CAO checks are repeatable rules. AI can help build the integration, but production checks do not need a model.

in_practice.trigger: An approved attendance submission or adjustment reaches the agreed intake location.
steps: Validate the file schema, employee identity, approval and payroll period.
Apply versioned CAO rules and check duplicates, overlaps and unusual changes.
Post valid records through a tested AFAS import or connector, with duplicate protection.
Hold exceptions for payroll and manager review without changing pay.
Reconcile accepted records to AFAS and retain a before-and-after audit trail.
in_practice.human_gate: Managers approve source hours; payroll approves exceptions and rule changes. The final payroll release remains separately controlled.
systems: AFAS Profit imports or connectors, subject to validation
SharePoint rule register and exception queue
data_needed: Employee identifiers and effective-dated employment records
Actual attendance source and its approval status
Applicable CAO, allowance and overtime rules
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS change history where available and a restricted SharePoint payroll control register.

evidence.claim: Structured attendance and adjustment records can be validated against explicit rules before import.
AFAS Profit provides payroll administration capabilities; Noordhaven's exact import and connector configuration requires checking.

risks: Applying the transport CAO to warehouse employees, or using an outdated allowance rule.
Posting a late correction twice or into a closed payroll period.
Treating agency workers as employees on Noordhaven's payroll.
Attendance monitoring changes may require OR consent and an AVG assessment.
research_questions: Where are attendance records captured, and do they contain reliable employee identifiers and manager approval?
Which CAO checks already run in AFAS, and which still require manual work?
Can the available AFAS interface support validated imports, duplicate protection and reconciliation?

tasks.short: Calculate pay and deductions, then check the payroll run in AFAS.

today.trigger: Approved payroll inputs are ready for a preliminary or final payroll run.
steps: Check approved salary, hours, allowances and deductions.
Run AFAS payroll calculations for the period.
Review gross-to-net movements and manually calculated exceptions.
Resolve errors and rerun affected calculations.
Prepare the checked payroll for independent release approval.
systems: SharePoint CAO documents and payroll procedures
drudgery: Checking the same predictable movements every month
today.time_sinks: AFAS already performs the core calculations; the opportunity depends on how much manual preparation and exception checking remains.

lenses.faster: Feed approved changes directly into AFAS and automatically compare the preliminary run with expected movements. Remove separate arithmetic where AFAS can calculate it.
lenses.autonomous: When inputs are approved and the period is ready, prepare a preliminary calculation and control report. Finalization and payment require human approval.
lenses.ambitious: Estimate payroll effects before changes take effect, reducing unexpected net pay and month-end corrections.
lenses.joy: Spend less time checking arithmetic and more time solving complex pay cases accurately.
lenses.options: Calculate supported scenarios for overtime, retroactive corrections and benefit changes using the payroll engine. Clearly label assumptions and preliminary results.
lenses.altitude: Manage payroll calculation controls, rule updates and release quality instead of maintaining parallel spreadsheets.
reach: Support Compensation and Benefits with verified pay scenarios.
Help Finance forecast payroll liabilities and cash requirements.

tasks.human_edge: Approve unusual deductions, resolve disputed entitlements and judge whether a calculation is legally and contractually justified.
tasks.pattern_why: Tax, pension and CAO calculations belong in a maintained payroll engine. The improvement is controlled input automation and verification around AFAS, not model-generated wages.

in_practice.trigger: The payroll cutoff is reached and required source approvals are complete.
steps: Validate input completeness, effective dates and authorized deductions.
Prepare the preliminary AFAS payroll calculation through supported functionality.
Compare employee and total results with expected changes and prior periods.
Present exceptions, correction options and supporting evidence to payroll.
Rerun approved corrections and produce a reconciled release pack.
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll approves exceptions and the completed calculation; an independent authorized person approves finalization and any Rabobank payment batch.
systems: Rabobank for the separately approved payment process
data_needed: Current AFAS tax, pension and payroll configuration
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS payroll run records and a restricted payroll release register containing approvals and reconciled totals.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit calculates payroll using configured payroll components.
Expected-change comparisons can reduce manual review of routine payroll movements.

risks: Automating an incorrect payroll configuration produces consistent errors at scale.
Retroactive changes can affect tax, pension and multiple previous periods.
Incorrect or unauthorized deductions can breach employee rights.
Combining calculation and payment authority weakens separation of duties.
research_questions: How much of the 111.2 annual hours is manual arithmetic versus review of existing AFAS results?
Which payroll components or retroactive cases currently require spreadsheets?
Who owns configuration updates, and what independent controls must pass before finalization and payment?

tasks.short: Keep leave balances and sickness hours accurate for payroll.

today.trigger: An approved leave request, sickness registration or corrected shift changes an employee's record.
steps: Collect approved leave and absence changes.
Check dates, scheduled hours and the applicable leave category.
Update or verify AFAS records and balances.
Resolve overlaps, incorrect accruals and payroll effects.
Confirm corrections with the employee or responsible HR colleague.
systems: AFAS Profit leave and absence records
Microsoft Excel where balances are checked separately
drudgery: Reconciling hours with changing shift patterns
today.time_sinks: Assumed manual work lies in exceptions and reconciliation; existing AFAS leave workflows may already cover much of the routine recording.

lenses.faster: Use approved leave events and effective-dated schedules to update balances and detect overlaps automatically.
lenses.autonomous: An approved leave change triggers recalculation and payroll impact checks. Ambiguous categories or conflicting hours remain pending.
lenses.ambitious: Give employees reliable balances throughout the month and detect errors before they reach their payslip.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated balance arithmetic and searching through email. Keep explaining difficult leave entitlements and fixing cases fairly.
lenses.options: Show how proposed leave dates affect balances under the employee's actual schedule. Keep sickness and statutory leave decisions outside scenario optimization.
lenses.altitude: Own the consistency of leave rules and payroll interfaces across sites, schedules and CAOs.
reach: Help HR Administration improve leave self-service.
Provide approved payroll absence inputs to the HR Business Partners.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve disputed entitlements and unusual statutory leave cases; medical assessment and return-to-work decisions stay with the appropriate professionals.
tasks.pattern_why: Approved leave events, accrual rules and schedules support deterministic balance calculations. Medical information is unnecessary for this payroll task.

in_practice.trigger: An authorized leave or administrative absence record changes in AFAS.
steps: Read the approved category, dates and permitted administrative hours.
Match the record to the employee's schedule and applicable accrual rules.
Recalculate balances and check overlapping or inconsistent records.
Update supported records and route exceptions to the responsible colleague.
Reconcile payroll absence hours and provide a restricted balance explanation.
in_practice.human_gate: Existing leave approvals remain required; payroll reviews exceptions affecting pay. The workflow neither assesses illness nor makes Wet verbetering poortwachter decisions.
systems: Approved schedule source, to be identified
data_needed: CAO and statutory leave accrual rules
Only permitted administrative absence data, excluding diagnoses
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS leave change history and a restricted reconciliation register without medical details.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports leave and absence administration.
Schedule-aware rules can identify overlapping leave and reconcile balances.

risks: Applying office-day assumptions to rotating warehouse or transport shifts.
Incorrect treatment of statutory versus additional leave and expiry rules.
Exposing sickness information beyond authorized payroll access.
Confusing payroll absence records with the occupational health or reintegration record.
research_questions: Are approved schedules and leave categories consistently available in AFAS?
Which accrual, expiry and sickness-pay rules differ between the two CAOs?
What absence data may payroll access, and which controls keep medical information outside the workflow?

tasks.short: Update payroll records for tax credit choices, transfers and employees leaving.

today.trigger: HR approves a personnel change with a payroll effect.
steps: Read the approved change and supporting documents.
Check the employee, effective date and relevant payroll fields.
Update AFAS or verify changes made by HR Administration.
Check any retroactive or final-pay effect.
Record the source approval and resolve missing information.
drudgery: Searching for the latest version of a form
today.time_sinks: Assumed duplication between HR Administration and payroll; 'exemptions' is interpreted here as relevant Dutch payroll declarations, including loonheffingskorting choices.

lenses.faster: Use approved AFAS HR changes as the source for payroll updates. Remove duplicate entry and automatically check dates and required fields.
lenses.autonomous: An authorized transfer, departure or payroll declaration triggers a validated update. Conflicting declarations and closed-period effects go to payroll.
lenses.ambitious: Trace every payroll master-data change to its approval and detect stale records before each run.
lenses.joy: Remove copying between forms and records. Keep helping employees and HR resolve consequential changes.
lenses.options: Preview the payroll impact of alternative effective dates when HR is considering a change. Only the approved date is posted.
lenses.altitude: Define who owns each payroll field and how changes are approved, applied and checked.
reach: Help HR Administration strengthen employee lifecycle workflows.
Support the Controller with payroll master-data controls.

tasks.human_edge: Verify authorization and resolve disputed departure dates, tax declarations or changes with significant employee consequences.
tasks.pattern_why: Approved structured changes can map directly to payroll fields with explicit validation. Free-text requests should first become approved structured records.

in_practice.trigger: An approved HR change reaches its effective date or payroll processing window.
steps: Read the approved change identifier, employee and effective date.
Validate source authority, required declarations and dependencies.
Apply permitted field updates through the existing AFAS workflow or tested interface.
Hold retroactive conflicts and final-pay exceptions for review.
Verify the resulting record and retain the approval and field-level changes.
in_practice.human_gate: HR or the employee provides the required source authorization; payroll approves exceptions. The workflow never decides that someone should leave or transfer.
data_needed: Employee identifiers and current payroll fields
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS master-data history and a restricted change register linking each update to its approved source.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit combines HR records and payroll administration.
Effective-dated, approved master-data updates can be automated with field validation and audit records.

risks: A transfer changes the applicable CAO or allowance eligibility without updating related fields.
An incorrect departure date causes erroneous final pay.
Sensitive declarations become accessible through overly broad SharePoint permissions.
Source approvals are bypassed because a request appears complete.
research_questions: Which changes already flow from AFAS HR to payroll without re-entry?
Can each change be linked to a reliable approval and effective date?
Which fields and departure calculations must remain subject to individual payroll review?

tasks.short: Find payroll differences, explain them and get the right corrections approved.

today.trigger: A preliminary payroll run, employee query or attendance check reveals a possible discrepancy.
steps: Collect the payslip calculation, approved hours and relevant change records.
Compare expected pay with the recorded result.
Trace differences to input, configuration or timing problems.
Discuss unclear cases with managers, HR or Finance.
Apply approved corrections and verify the revised result.
systems: Power BI for historical trends, using the nightly extract
drudgery: Finding the source of a changed payroll component
today.time_sinks: Tracing changes across hours, employee records and payroll components; nightly Power BI data cannot verify same-day corrections.

lenses.faster: Automatically reconcile source hours, approved changes and payroll components. Present each unexplained difference with its supporting records.
lenses.autonomous: Each preliminary run produces an exception list and evidence packs. Corrections remain subject to approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check every employee and payroll component, then track whether recurring causes disappear after fixes.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet comparison and document hunting. Keep investigation, judgment and conversations that restore trust.
lenses.options: Present several supported explanations and correction scenarios, distinguishing verified facts from unresolved possibilities.
lenses.altitude: Manage payroll error prevention and control coverage instead of investigating the same failures each month.
reach: Support the Controller's payroll reconciliation.
Help the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst improve source-data quality.

tasks.human_edge: Determine the correct entitlement when evidence conflicts and explain corrections, especially overpayments, respectfully and lawfully.
tasks.pattern_why: Investigation crosses records, calculations and approvals. Deterministic comparisons assemble evidence; a bounded assistant can draft explanations, while payroll approves conclusions and corrections.

in_practice.trigger: A preliminary payroll run completes or an authorized discrepancy case is opened.
steps: Reconcile current AFAS results against approved source records and expected changes.
Group unexplained differences by employee, component and likely source.
Retrieve permitted supporting records and draft an evidence-linked explanation.
Have payroll select the verified cause and approve any correction.
Apply approved corrections through supported controls and rerun reconciliation.
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll approves each correction and any employee-facing explanation. No anomaly score may trigger withholding, recovery or disciplinary action.
systems: Power BI for historical error trends
Optional approved language-model service for redacted explanation drafts
data_needed: Current and prior payroll component results
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted payroll case register with evidence references, draft versions, approvals and reconciled corrections.

evidence.claim: Rule-based reconciliation can identify differences between approved inputs and payroll results.
An assistant can draft an explanation from supplied evidence, but its proposed cause requires verification.

risks: A plausible explanation hides a missing or incorrect source record.
Expected changes are flagged repeatedly, creating review fatigue.
Stale dashboard data is treated as the current payroll result.
Employee-level anomaly scoring expands into employment assessment; that would require a separate AVG and EU AI Act assessment where applicable.
research_questions: Which discrepancies occur most often, and what share can explicit reconciliation rules explain?
Can current-period AFAS component results be accessed with their source change history?
Does an evidence-pack pilot reduce investigation time without increasing missed errors or incorrect corrections?

tasks.short: Complete attendance records from actual arrival and departure times.

today.trigger: A shift ends or a manager submits missing attendance information.
steps: Collect available arrival and departure records.
Match records to employees, shifts and dates.
Identify missing punches, overnight shifts and break questions.
Obtain confirmation for exceptions from the responsible manager.
Complete the attendance record for later pay validation.
systems: AFAS Profit where attendance inputs are recorded
today.time_sinks: Missing punches and inconsistent site formats; automation depends on access to actual attendance records rather than planned shifts.

lenses.faster: Pair actual arrival and departure events automatically, including overnight shifts. Route incomplete records directly to the responsible manager.
lenses.autonomous: A completed pair of attendance events creates a draft timesheet line. Missing or conflicting events remain unresolved until confirmed.
lenses.ambitious: Make complete attendance records available after every shift and expose repeated capture failures by site.
lenses.joy: Remove timestamp copying and midnight arithmetic. Keep resolving unusual shifts and helping sites improve capture.
lenses.options: Show alternative event pairings when records are ambiguous. Never present a planned shift as proof of hours actually worked.
lenses.altitude: Set attendance capture standards and monitor completeness across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.
reach: Help warehouse and transport managers improve attendance administration.
Provide approved agency attendance records for Finance's invoice checks.

tasks.human_edge: Confirm missing or disputed times with people who know what happened; software cannot reconstruct actual work from a schedule alone.
tasks.pattern_why: Pairing timestamps and checking completeness are explicit rules. Missing evidence requires confirmation, not a model prediction.

in_practice.trigger: Actual attendance events become available after a shift.
steps: Import events with source identifiers, timestamps and employee references.
Pair arrivals and departures using tested overnight and daylight-saving rules.
Separate complete records from missing, duplicated or conflicting events.
Ask managers to confirm exceptions through the existing approval workflow.
Publish approved attendance lines to the agreed payroll input location.
in_practice.human_gate: Managers confirm exceptions and approve attendance under the site's policy; payroll retains downstream pay checks.
systems: Existing attendance source, to be identified
data_needed: Actual timestamp events and stable source identifiers
Site time zone and shift context
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted attendance register preserving original events, approved corrections and import status.

evidence.claim: Timestamp pairing and overnight-shift checks can be implemented with deterministic rules.
The proposed event-triggered attendance flow depends on a usable capture source that Noordhaven has not specified.

risks: Planned hours or assumed breaks replace evidence of actual work.
Overnight shifts, daylight-saving changes or duplicate events produce incorrect durations.
Rounding rules systematically disadvantage employees.
Expanded employee monitoring requires appropriate OR involvement and AVG controls.
research_questions: What captures actual arrival and departure times at each site, and can it export reliable events?
How many attendance records require manual confirmation today?
What break, rounding and approval rules apply, and have the relevant monitoring arrangements been agreed with the OR?

tasks.short: Set up new employees in payroll from approved starter information.

today.trigger: HR confirms a new employee's contract and start date.
steps: Collect approved contract details and required payroll declarations.
Check identity verification status, completeness and employment terms.
Create or verify the employee's AFAS payroll record.
Resolve missing details with HR Administration or the employee.
Check first-payroll readiness and record the completed checks.
systems: SharePoint contract templates and restricted documents
drudgery: Checking the same mandatory fields for every starter
today.time_sinks: Incomplete handovers near the cutoff; an accepted Recruitee offer does not by itself establish payroll authorization or verified identity.

lenses.faster: Collect starter data through structured, restricted forms and reuse approved contract fields. Automatically identify missing information before payroll setup.
lenses.autonomous: An approved HR starter record triggers a completeness check and draft payroll setup. Missing or conflicting information is routed to its owner.
lenses.ambitious: Give every starter a first-pay readiness check before their start date, reducing pay problems during the first 90 days.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated entry and document chasing. Keep resolving unusual contracts and reassuring employees about their first pay.
lenses.options: Preview first-month pay under the approved start date and alternative cutoff handling. Label estimates and obtain approval for any exception.
lenses.altitude: Own the payroll-readiness standard within the vacancy-to-day-90 process.
reach: Help HR Administration improve starter handovers.
Give recruiters a simple payroll-readiness status without exposing sensitive payroll data.

tasks.human_edge: Confirm that required identity checks and declarations have been completed, and resolve unusual contracts or conflicting personal details.
tasks.pattern_why: Setup involves several sources, completeness checks and exceptions. Structured data and rules should do most of the work, with payroll approving the completed record before activation.

in_practice.trigger: HR approves the starter record and contract for payroll preparation.
steps: Collect approved structured contract and starter fields from restricted sources.
Check required declarations, identity verification status and employee duplication.
Prepare an AFAS payroll record with source references and unresolved fields clearly marked.
Route missing information to HR Administration or the employee through existing channels.
Have payroll approve activation and verify inclusion in the intended first payroll.
in_practice.human_gate: Authorized staff complete identity checks; payroll approves the new payroll record and consequential exceptions before activation.
systems: Recruitee for minimal recruitment handover status
data_needed: Approved contract, start date, salary and applicable CAO
Verified employee identity and required payroll identifiers
Authorized bank details and payroll declarations
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS setup history and a restricted starter checklist containing approvals and source references.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports employee records and payroll administration.
Structured starter intake and completeness checks can reduce duplicate entry and incomplete payroll handovers.

risks: An offer or draft contract is mistaken for an approved employment record.
Incorrect bank details or duplicate employees enter payroll.
BSN, identity documents or bank details are copied into general-purpose model prompts or recruitment records.
Agency workers are incorrectly enrolled in Noordhaven payroll.
research_questions: Which starter fields already enter AFAS through HR Administration, and where is payroll duplicating entry?
Can identity checks, bank-detail validation and payroll declarations be evidenced without copying sensitive documents between systems?
What proportion of first-payroll issues comes from missing data, late approval or incorrect setup?

tasks.short: Bring approved hours and payroll inputs together for the pay run.

today.trigger: A regular payroll preparation window opens or a site submits an updated input file.
steps: Collect approved time, production-related pay inputs and personnel changes.
Align employee identifiers, dates and payroll periods.
Combine records into the required payroll input structure.
Check source totals and identify missing submissions.
Hand the compiled dataset to payroll validation.
systems: Staffing agency portals for separately handled agency records
drudgery: Renaming columns and fixing date formats
today.time_sinks: Assumed fragmentation across site files; production-based pay inputs are relevant only if Noordhaven actually uses them.

lenses.faster: Use reusable imports to standardize approved files and reconcile their totals. Remove manual workbook assembly.
lenses.autonomous: Each approved submission updates a controlled period dataset and its completeness status. Unexpected formats stop that source's import.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a current view of payroll input completeness throughout the month, with traceability back to every source.
lenses.joy: Remove downloads, column repairs and file merging. Keep improving source quality and resolving missing inputs.
lenses.options: Produce period, site and cost-centre views from the same validated dataset. Compare actual submissions with expected coverage without inventing missing hours.
lenses.altitude: Own the payroll input pipeline, source contracts and reconciliation standards.
reach: Provide reconciled payroll inputs for Finance's labour-cost analysis.
Prepare separate agency-hours datasets for accounts payable invoice matching.

tasks.human_edge: Decide whether a source is authoritative and whether an unfamiliar pay input belongs in payroll; missing information must remain visible.
tasks.pattern_why: Compilation is structured extraction, mapping and reconciliation. AI can help create import code, while the recurring workflow runs without a model.

in_practice.trigger: An approved source submission arrives or the scheduled completeness check runs.
steps: Fetch available submissions through supported exports or read-only interfaces.
Validate schemas, employee mappings, dates and source approvals.
Standardize and combine records with duplicate protection and source references.
Reconcile row counts, hours and amounts to source control totals.
Publish the compiled dataset and hold missing or invalid sources for review.
in_practice.human_gate: Source owners approve submissions; payroll resolves mapping and completeness exceptions before downstream validation. Compilation does not authorize pay.
systems: AFAS Profit extracts and approved intake
Staffing agency exports or interfaces, if available
Power BI for historical completeness reporting
data_needed: Source schemas and payroll component mappings
Expected site submissions and period calendar
Source control totals and employee-versus-agency status
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted payroll intake register recording source versions, validation results, control totals and dataset versions.

evidence.claim: Structured files can be mapped, combined and reconciled through repeatable software pipelines.
Cross-system automation at Noordhaven depends on export availability and stable source formats that have not been established.

risks: Silent source-format changes map values into the wrong payroll fields.
Employee and agency-worker records are mixed.
Repeated imports duplicate hours or allowances.
Missing submissions are interpreted as zero hours instead of unresolved inputs.
research_questions: Which inputs genuinely arrive outside AFAS, in what formats and with what control totals?
Do the three agencies provide usable exports or interfaces, and should Finance own their separate dataset?
Can a pilot reconcile every compiled record to its approved source while reducing manual preparation time?

role.altitude: Payroll control owner: maintain reliable inputs, tested CAO rules, clear approvals and accurate first-time pay across the three sites.
reach: Payroll-readiness checks within HR Administration's starter and leaver workflows
Verified pay scenarios for Compensation and Benefits
Payroll-to-ledger reconciliation support for the Controller and Accountant
Separate agency-hours evidence for accounts payable invoice matching
Payroll data-quality requirements for the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst
Payroll input standards with warehouse and transport managers
role.ceiling_note: The eight tasks cover 778.1 hours annually, about 48.6% of a 1,600-hour role. The estimates imply roughly 378 hours of potential human effort released, worth about EUR 20,800 at EUR 55/hour, before implementation, support and overlap adjustments. These are unvalidated estimates, not cash savings or evidence that the position can be removed. Existing AFAS automation may substantially reduce the opportunity; approval queues and payroll schedules limit end-to-end speed. Attendance completion, compilation, validation and discrepancy work must be measured separately to avoid double counting. Final pay accountability, disputed entitlements and independent payment approval remain human responsibilities.
skills_to_grow: Effective-dated CAO rule specification and payroll configuration testing
AFAS import and connector controls, reconciliation and duplicate protection
Payroll data ownership and source approval design
Exception analysis and prevention of recurring errors
AVG access control, retention and handling of sensitive payroll data
Working with the OR on changes to attendance and personnel-data systems
Assessing EU AI Act obligations if a future tool moves into employee evaluation or employment decisions
Explaining complex pay issues clearly to employees and managers
role.ambitious_version: Run a continuously checked payroll process in which approved changes and actual hours are ready before cutoff, every unexplained pay movement has traceable evidence, and every starter receives a first-pay readiness check. Use released time to prevent recurring errors, improve payroll service for shift workers and give Finance reliable labour-cost inputs. Build on AFAS first; introduce a model only where an evidence-linked draft materially helps a human reviewer. Track correct first pay, avoidable corrections and employee queries alongside onboarding and 90-day retention.
